item.title: Ask Murph to leave a group
item.summary: Ask Murph to leave a group chat and it stops replying there, with no goodbye and no private message.
item.details: Murph also leaves on its own when a group is clearly bots talking to each other or spam. It won't leave a group that has had a game. Asking Murph to be quiet is not the same as asking it to leave. Murph may still show in the group's member list after it leaves.
